Now I have a comprehensive picture. Here is the complete summary of all Launchpad-related code in this codebase:

---

## Complete Launchpad Code Inventory

### 1. Launchpad Client/API Code

**`/project/src/project_health/providers/launchpad.py`** (565 lines)
- **`LaunchpadClient`** (lines 37-161): Read-only async API client for Launchpad's REST API (`https://api.launchpad.net/devel`)
  - Only allows GET and HEAD requests (enforced at line 61-62)
  - Uses `httpx.AsyncClient` with JSON accept headers
  - Has a separate `_git_client` for Atom feed commits
  - Key methods:
    - `request()` / `get()` / `paginate()` / `paginate_optional()` - core HTTP
    - `bug_tasks(target, since)` - fetch bug tasks via `searchTasks` operation
    - `repository(repo)` - fetch repository metadata
    - `commits(repo, since)` - fetch commits via Atom feed
    - `git_atom_commits(repository, ref, since)` - parse git Atom XML feed
    - `merge_proposals(repo, since)` - fetch merge proposals via `getMergeProposals` operation
    - `code_review_comments(link)` - fetch review comments from collection link
    - `vote_references(link)` - fetch vote references from collection link
    - `person(name)` / `team(name)` - fetch user/team metadata

**`/project/src/project_health/providers/launchpad_oauth.py`** (166 lines)
- **`LaunchpadOAuthCredentials`** (dataclass, line 22-27): Holds consumer_key, access_token, access_token_secret
- **`LaunchpadRequestToken`** (dataclass, line 31-35): Temporary request token during OAuth flow
- **`LaunchpadOAuthError`** (exception, line 17-18): Custom error for OAuth failures
- Key functions:
  - `oauth_authorization_header()` - builds OAuth PLAINTEXT Authorization header
  - `signed_headers(credentials)` - returns dict of signed HTTP headers
  - `request_token(consumer_key)` - initiates OAuth flow with Launchpad
  - `authorize_url(token)` - builds browser authorization URL
  - `exchange_request_token(consumer_key, request)` - exchanges for access credentials
  - `parse_oauth_token_response(body)` - parses form-encoded token response

---

### 2. Launchpad Data Models (Configuration)

**`/project/src/project_health/config/loader.py`**
- **`TeamMember`** (line 38-44): has `launchpad: str | None` field for LP username
- **`LaunchpadConfig`** (line 60-63): Empty model (rejects extra fields like base_url)
- **`LaunchpadBugTargetConfig`** (lines 66-78): Bug target with `name`, `display_name`, `statuses`; string coercion supported
- **`LaunchpadRepositoryConfig`** (lines 81-131): Git repository with `path`, `owner`, `context`, `repository`, `display_name`; auto-parses `~owner/context/+git/repository` format
- **`LaunchpadCredentials`** (lines 152-157): `consumer_key`, `access_token`, `access_token_secret`
- **`parse_launchpad_repo_path()`** (lines 134-141): regex parser for canonical LP repo paths
- **`Config`** (lines 195+): Root config with:
  - `launchpad_bugs` / `launchpad_repos` (top-level or nested under `projects:`)
  - `credentials.launchpad` (optional)
  - `bots.launchpad` (bot exclusions)
  - Properties: `all_launchpad_bug_targets`, `all_launchpad_repositories`, `launchpad_bots`
  - Validators: pulls nested launchpad targets, rejects duplicates
- **`ProjectsConfig`** (line 276-281): `launchpad: list[LaunchpadBugTargetConfig] | None` (legacy)
- **`BotsConfig`** (lines 182-192): `launchpad: list[str]`

---

### 3. Launchpad Merge Proposals (MPs) Handling

**`/project/src/project_health/providers/launchpad.py`**

- **`LaunchpadClient.merge_proposals(repo, since)`** (lines 127-136):
  - Calls `getMergeProposals` with `modified_since` and pagination
  - Supports both `~owner/context/+git/repo` paths and bare repo names
  - Returns 404-tolerant (empty list on missing resources)

- **`_merge_proposal_event(repo, proposal)`** (lines 386-416):
  - Converts a raw LP merge proposal dict into `RawChangeRequestEvent`
  - Extracts: external_id, timestamp (date_created/date_review_requested), actor (registrant_link)
  - Data fields: title (commit_message or description), state (normalized), queue_status, merged_at, closed_at, source/target branches, html_url, source_kind="merge_proposal", normalized_kind="change_request"
  - Includes `REVIEW_CAPABILITIES["launchpad"]` in the data

- **`_vote_reference_event(repo, proposal, vote)`** (lines 419-443):
  - Converts a vote reference into `RawReviewRequestEvent`
  - Links reviewer to merge proposal via `change_request_external_id`

- **`_review_decision_event(repo, proposal, comment)`** (lines 446-474):
  - Converts a code review comment with a vote into `RawReviewDecisionEvent`
  - Only produces events when a vote is present and normalizable

- **`_review_comment_event(repo, proposal, comment)`** (lines 477-503):
  - Converts a code review comment into `RawReviewCommentEvent`
  - Only produces events when content is non-empty

- **`normalize_launchpad_mp_state(queue_status)`** (lines 537-547):
  - Maps LP statuses: "merged"/"merged proposal" -> "merged"; "rejected"/"superseded" -> "superseded"; "work in progress"/"needs review"/"approved" -> "open"; "closed"/"abandoned" -> "closed"

---

### 4. Mapping Between Launchpad MPs and Unified/Abstract Model

**`/project/src/project_health/providers/protocol.py`** (213 lines)
- Defines the **abstract event models** that Launchpad maps into:
  - `RawPREvent` (line 88-95) - "A pull request / merge proposal event"
  - `RawChangeRequestEvent` (line 108-115) - "A provider-neutral change request event"
  - `RawReviewRequestEvent` (line 118-125) - "A provider-neutral review request event"
  - `RawReviewDecisionEvent` (line 128-135) - "A provider-neutral review decision event"
  - `RawReviewCommentEvent` (line 138-145) - "A provider-neutral review comment event"
  - `RawCommitEvent` (line 78-85), `RawIssueEvent` (line 148-155)

- **`SOURCE_CAPABILITIES`** (lines 27-49): Declares Launchpad supports: pull_request, pull_request_review, commit, issue, change_request, review_request, review_decision, review_comment

- **`REVIEW_CAPABILITIES["launchpad"]`** (lines 60-67): review_comments=True, inline_comments="unknown", review_requests=True, review_decisions=True, approval_state="source_specific"

- **`DataSourceProvider` Protocol** (lines 169-213): The interface that `LaunchpadProvider` implements

**`/project/src/project_health/providers/launchpad.py`** - The `LaunchpadProvider` class:
- `fetch_pull_requests()` (lines 192-203): Wraps `fetch_change_requests()` and converts each `RawChangeRequestEvent` into a `RawPREvent` (dual representation for backward compatibility)
- `fetch_change_requests()` (lines 205-212): Maps merge proposals to `RawChangeRequestEvent` via `_merge_proposal_event()`
- `fetch_pull_request_reviews()` (lines 214-225): Wraps `fetch_review_decisions()` into `RawReviewEvent`
- `fetch_review_requests()` (lines 227-238): Maps vote references
- `fetch_review_decisions()` (lines 240-251): Maps review comments with votes
- `fetch_review_comments()` (lines 253-264): Maps all review comments

**Key normalization functions:**
- `normalize_launchpad_bug_status()` (lines 506-521): LP bug status -> unified status (open/ready/in_progress/done/cancelled/etc.)
- `normalize_launchpad_vote()` (lines 524-534): LP vote -> unified (approved/changes_requested/needs_information/rejected/neutral)
- `normalize_launchpad_mp_state()` (lines 537-547): LP queue_status -> unified state (merged/superseded/open/closed)

---

### 5. Tests for Launchpad Integration

**`/project/tests/test_launchpad_provider.py`** (399 lines) -- Primary test file:
- `test_launchpad_client_rejects_write_methods` - Verifies read-only guard
- `test_launchpad_client_uses_devel_api_root` - Confirms API base URL
- `test_launchpad_client_uses_oauth_signed_headers` - OAuth header verification

- `test_atom_commit_events_filters_by_since` - Atom feed date filtering
- `test_launchpad_merge_proposals_skip_missing_resource` - 404 tolerance for MPs

- `test_launchpad_bug_status_mapping` - Status normalization

- `test_launchpad_review_comments_use_collection_link` - End-to-end provider review comments
- `test_public_launchpad_cassette_shapes_normalize` - Cassette-based integration test

**`/project/tests/test_launchpad_oauth.py`** (105 lines):
- `test_oauth_authorization_header_uses_plaintext_signature` - Header format
- `test_signed_headers_use_access_credentials` - Credential signing

### 6. Sync/Fetch Logic for Launchpad Data

**`/project/src/project_health/ingestion/scheduler.py`** (289 lines):
